title: The Metabolite indole-3-acetic acid of Bacteroides ovatus ameliorates ovariectomy-induced bone loss by activating AhR and inhibiting oxidative stress.
authors: Cui, Peng; Zhang, Haojie; Hu, Tao; Huang, Qingyang; Hu, Xinli; Wang, Qijun; Diwan, Ashish D; Wang, Tianlong; Zhao, Xuan; Lu, Shibao; Chen, Xiaolong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肠道菌群代谢物IAA通过AhR信号改善骨质疏松，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Postmenopausal osteoporosis represents a systemic skeletal condition distinguished by diminished bone mass and heightened skeletal fragility. Emerging evidence has highlighted a significant relationship between bone metabolism and disturbances in gut microbiota (GM) homeostasis. However, the exact mechanisms by which GM dysbiosis contributes to postmenopausal osteoporosis remain insufficiently understood. Herein, integrating weighted gene co-expression network analysis with machine learning, a notable depletion of Bacteroides ovatus (B. ovatus) was identified in the GM of women with postmenopausal osteoporosis. Metagenomic sequencing further validated the reduced abundance of B. ovatus in ovariectomized (OVX) mice. Notably, live B. ovatus (LBO), but not heat-killed B. ovatus (KBO), effectively mitigated bone loss in OVX mice and restored intestinal mucosal barrier integrity. Both untargeted and targeted metabolomic profiling revealed substantial alterations in tryptophan metabolism in OVX mice, particularly a significant reduction in indole-3-acetic acid (IAA). Oral supplementation with IAA notably alleviated bone loss in OVX mice. Mechanistically, IAA stimulated AhR, enhancing NQO1 expression, reducing intracellular ROS buildup, and ultimately suppressing osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption. This investigation demonstrates, for the first time, the protective effects of B. ovatus and its metabolite IAA in counteracting estrogen deficiency-induced bone loss and may present a promising microbial-targeted strategy for osteoporosis prevention.
abstract_zh: 绝经后骨质疏松症是一种以骨量减少和骨骼脆性增加为特征的系统性骨骼疾病。新兴证据强调了骨代谢与肠道菌群（GM）稳态紊乱之间的显著关系。然而，肠道菌群失调导致绝经后骨质疏松症的确切机制仍未被充分理解。在此，通过整合加权基因共表达网络分析与机器学习，在绝经后骨质疏松症女性的肠道菌群中鉴定出卵形拟杆菌（B. ovatus）的显著减少。宏基因组测序进一步验证了去卵巢（OVX）小鼠中卵形拟杆菌丰度的降低。值得注意的是，活卵形拟杆菌（LBO），而非热灭活卵形拟杆菌（KBO），有效缓解了OVX小鼠的骨丢失，并恢复了肠道黏膜屏障的完整性。非靶向和靶向代谢组学分析均揭示了OVX小鼠中色氨酸代谢的显著变化，特别是吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）的显著减少。口服补充IAA显著减轻了OVX小鼠的骨丢失。机制上，IAA激活了AhR，增强了NQO1表达，减少了细胞内ROS积累，并最终抑制了破骨细胞分化和骨吸收。本研究首次证明了卵形拟杆菌及其代谢物IAA在对抗雌激素缺乏诱导的骨丢失中的保护作用，并可能为骨质疏松症预防提供一种有前景的微生物靶向策略。
